title: Warranty Coverage Crew Rate for Missed Visits by Installation Method
content:
**Standard.** Under Warranty Coverage, a missed technician visit is booked for the crew the openings need, and the crew is set by the method of the installation job that installed the covered openings, as the Installation Jobs records show it:

- A missed visit to openings whose installation job used the **Bay and Bow Installation** method was booked for three technicians and takes the three-technician crew rate of **3.0**.
- A missed visit to openings whose installation job used the **Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap** method or the **Masonry Opening Installation** method was booked for two technicians and takes the two-technician crew rate of **2.0**.
- A missed visit to openings installed by any other method takes no crew rate under this standard.

## Method and crew

| Installation method on the Installation Jobs record | Technicians booked | Crew rate |
|---|---|---|
| Bay and Bow Installation | three | 3.0 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | two | 2.0 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | two | 2.0 |
| any other method (for example Insert Pocket Installation, Full-Frame Installation, Door System Installation) | — | none |

## Points of judgement

- The method is read from the installation job recorded on the Warranty Coverage registration, the job whose completion started coverage.
- Full-Frame Installation alone is not the same method as Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap; only the latter takes the two-technician rate.
